Acquirer.name: Acquirer
Acquirer.definition: Acquirer involved in the card payment.

ServiceProvider.name: Service Provider
ServiceProvider.definition: Third party agent which provides services.

Merchant.name: Merchant
Merchant.definition: Merchant performing the card payment transaction.|Usage: In some cases, merchant and acceptor may be regarded as the same entity.

POI.name: POI
POI.definition: Point of interaction (POI) performing the transaction.

LoyaltyAccount.name: Loyalty Account
LoyaltyAccount.definition: Store value account associated to the payment.

CustomerDevice.name: Customer Device
CustomerDevice.definition: Device used by the customer to perform the payment transaction.

Wallet.name: Wallet
Wallet.definition: Container for tenders used by the customer to perform the payment transaction.

Cardholder.name: Cardholder
Cardholder.definition: Cardholder involved in the card payment.

ProtectedCardholderData.name: Protected Cardholder Data
ProtectedCardholderData.definition: Replacement of the message element Cardholder by a digital envelope using a cryptographic key.

SaleEnvironment.name: Sale Environment
SaleEnvironment.definition: Sale Retailer Environment for this message.

OneElementPresenceRule.definition: At least one of these subelements mut be present.
